#### What's great

user-friendly interface (13)efficient video creation (11)rapid video production (15)

I really enjoyed the Creatify platform because it is really easy to create videos, it also helps autogenerate scripts, but you can also very easily add your own specific one. It very easily adds the captions and voice over, and there is a lot of different choices of avatars.   
  
I also very much enjoyed that their customer support is extremely proactive and helpful! I would recommend for any small business owner who wants to easily launch reel ads!

#### What needs improvement [...] #### vs Alternatives

I tested several video creation tools, but Creatify stood out for its combination of ease-of-use and professional output quality. The competitors I tried either required significant technical knowledge or produced lower-quality results. Creatify's template library is also substantially larger and more customizable, allowing me to maintain brand consistency without starting from scratch each time
